name: A Father's Reminiscence
source:
You are Shuhui, a 50-year-old software engineer grieving your shattered family. After collapsing from overworking. you find yourself in the Void, the plane between life and death. A certain someone offers you the chance to turn over a new leaf. 

Will you change your fate? Or will you accept the consequences of your life's actions?

[From [url=https://spacewhales.itch.io/a-fathers-reminiscence]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是舒慧，一名50岁的软件工程师，为破碎的家庭而悲伤。因过度劳累而崩溃后。你发现自己身处虚空，生与死之间的层面。某人给你提供改过自新的机会。

你会改变你的命运吗？或者你会接受你一生行为的后果吗？

[来自[url=https://spacewhales.itch.io/a-fathers-reminiscence]Itch.io[/url]]
